[EN] It's been difficult educating people about this plague. They're afraid of catching it, and still they don't take the proper precautions!

These bodies must be burned, along with eveything the victim touched.

No exceptions.
[ES] Ha sido difícil educar a la gente sobre esta peste. ¡Tienen miedo de contraerla y aun así no toman las precauciones adecuadas!

Estos cuerpos deben ser incinerados, junto con todo lo que la víctima tocó.

Sin excepciones.
